Package theknife.client

Class Controller

java.lang.Object
theknife.client.Controller
public final class Controller extends Object
This class manages all datasets and data handling in TheKnife project.
Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 760743 (CO)

    • advancedSearch

      public final void advancedSearch(String city, Double rating, Integer price, boolean[] booleanCuisines, boolean[] booleanServices)
      Searches for restaurants based on city, rating, price, cuisines, and services. Filters are applied sequentially and results are visualized.
      Parameters:
      city - The city of the restaurant (null for no filter).
      rating - The minimum rating (null for no filter).
      price - The target price (null for no filter).
      booleanCuisines - Array of boolean values for included cuisines (null for no filter).
      booleanServices - Array of boolean values for included services (null for no filter).
      See Also:
      • Restaurant
      • Home.visualizeAdvancedSearchResult(java.util.List<theknife.obj.restaurant.Restaurant>)
